from collections import deque

def components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, out = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = {(r, c)}
            seen.add((r, c))
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); cells.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def is_l(cells):
    rs = [r for r,c in cells]; cs = [c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    h,w = r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    if h < 2 or w < 2 or len(cells) != h+w-1:
        return False
    return (all((r0,c) in cells for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((r,c1) in cells for r in range(r0,r1+1))) or \
           (all((r0,c) in cells for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((r,c0) in cells for r in range(r0,r1+1))) or \
           (all((r1,c) in cells for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((r,c1) in cells for r in range(r0,r1+1))) or \
           (all((r1,c) in cells for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((r,c0) in cells for r in range(r0,r1+1)))

def transform(grid):
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    objs = components(grid, bg)
    keys = [(color, cells) for color,cells in objs if is_l(cells)]
    if len(keys) != 1:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    key_color, key_cells = keys[0]
    candidates = [(color,cells) for color,cells in objs if cells != key_cells]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, target = max(candidates, key=lambda obj: len(obj[1]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c] = key_color
    return out
